tags.title: Post Title
tags.note: Outputs the title of the current post, page, or template.

tags.title: Post Date
tags.note: Outputs the publication date of the current post. Supports standard and custom date formats (e.g. F j, Y).

tags.title: Post Time
tags.note: Outputs the publication time of the current post. Supports standard and custom time formats (e.g. g:i a).

tags.title: Post ID
tags.note: Outputs the unique numeric database ID of the current post, page, or template.

tags.title: Page Title
tags.note: Outputs the title of the current page/document. Ideal for general-purpose layouts.

tags.title: Post Excerpt
tags.note: Outputs the custom excerpt of the current post. Falls back to post content if the excerpt is empty.

tags.title: Post Custom Field
tags.note: Retrieves the value of a post meta key. Useful for displaying custom database fields.

tags.title: Post Terms
tags.note: Lists all terms assigned to the post from a selected taxonomy (e.g. Categories, Tags, custom taxonomies) with custom separators.

tags.title: Post Featured Image
tags.note: Retrieves the featured image object, compatible with Elementor's image and background controls.

tags.title: Post Gallery
tags.note: Pulls image attachments or gallery field IDs from the post, compatible with Elementor's gallery widgets.

tags.title: Post URL
tags.note: Outputs the absolute permalink URL of the current post or page.

tags.title: Post Thumbnail URL
tags.note: Outputs the direct URL of the post's featured image.

tags.title: Post Categories List
tags.note: Displays a list of categories assigned to the post, with optional links.

tags.title: Post Tags List
tags.note: Displays a list of tags assigned to the post, with optional links.

tags.title: Post Modified Date
tags.note: Outputs the date when the post was last modified. Supports custom formatting.

tags.title: Post Comment Count
tags.note: Outputs the total number of approved comments on the post.

tags.title: Query String Parameter
tags.note: Retrieves a specific GET parameter from the URL query string. Example: ?ref=xxx retrieves xxx.

tags.title: Post Content
tags.note: Retrieves the main post content. Useful for displaying classic editor text blocks.

tags.title: Post Parent
tags.note: Returns parent post ID, title, or link. Returns 'no parent' if the post type is hierarchical but has no parent.

tags.title: Post Status
tags.note: Outputs the current post status (e.g. publish, draft, private).

tags.title: Post Type
tags.note: Outputs the name of the post type. Supports singular, plural, and raw labels.

tags.title: Are Comments Allowed
tags.note: Returns 1 if comments are open for the current post, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is 404
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current page is a 404 error page, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Home
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current page is the blog posts index, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Front Page
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current page is the static front page, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Singular
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current view is any single post, page, or custom post type, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Feed
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current request is for a feed (e.g., RSS feed), otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Current User Author Of Post
tags.note: Returns 1 if the logged-in visitor is the author of the current post, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Post In Category
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current post is in the selected category/categories, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Is Post In List
tags.note: Returns 1 if the current post ID is present in the specified comma-separated list of IDs, otherwise 0.

tags.title: Number Posts Query
tags.note: Counts and returns the number of posts matching a custom query configuration.

tags.title: Archive Title
tags.note: Outputs the title of the current category, tag, taxonomy, or author archive page.

tags.title: Archive Description
tags.note: Outputs the description text of the current archive term or category.

tags.title: Archive Meta
tags.note: Retrieves custom term metadata associated with the current archive term by key.

tags.title: Archive URL
tags.note: Outputs the absolute permalink URL of the current archive page.

tags.title: Site Title
tags.note: Outputs the global site title configured in WordPress General Settings.

tags.title: Site Tagline
tags.note: Outputs the site tagline/description configured in WordPress General Settings.

tags.title: Site URL
tags.note: Outputs the absolute home page URL of the site, useful for custom button links.

tags.title: Internal URL
tags.note: Generates a link URL for any selected post, page, taxonomy term, attachment, or author.

tags.title: Shortcode
tags.note: Executes a shortcode and outputs the returned string or value. Useful for custom dynamic functions.

tags.title: Current Date Time
tags.note: Outputs the current date and time on the server. Supports custom formatting.

tags.title: Current URL
tags.note: Outputs the absolute request URL of the page currently being viewed.

tags.title: Current Language
tags.note: Outputs the active locale or language code (e.g., en, es, de) for multi-lingual configurations.

tags.title: Current User Can
tags.note: Checks if the logged-in user has a specific permission/capability. Returns 1 if true, 0 if false.

tags.title: Request Parameter
tags.note: Retrieves a parameter from URL (GET), form data (POST), or custom query variables. Example Key: utm_source.

tags.title: Cookies
tags.note: Reads a browser cookie value by name. Supports wildcard matching (e.g. wordpress_logged_in_*).

tags.title: Session
tags.note: Reads a PHP session value by key from $_SESSION. Requires active PHP sessions.

tags.title: Server Variables
tags.note: Retrieves value from the PHP $_SERVER array by key. Example: HTTP_USER_AGENT, REMOTE_ADDR.

tags.title: Widget Content
tags.note: Renders the exact HTML content of a specific Elementor widget from any page by Post ID and Widget ID.

tags.title: Featured Image
tags.note: Retrieves the post's featured image object, compatible with Elementor image tags.

tags.title: Featured Image Data
tags.note: Retrieves metadata of the featured image (alt text, caption, description, title, or file URL).

tags.title: Site Logo
tags.note: Retrieves the custom site logo image object uploaded via Theme Customizer.

tags.title: Site Icon
tags.note: Retrieves the site icon (favicon) image object uploaded via Theme Customizer.

tags.title: Contact URL
tags.note: Creates custom contact links (email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Viber, Waze, Skype, or Calendar links).

tags.title: Reload Page
tags.note: Generates an action link that reloads the current page when clicked.

tags.title: Lightbox
tags.note: Generates an action link that opens a specific image, video, or external URL in a popup lightbox.

tags.title: Off-Canvas
tags.note: Generates an action link to open/close an off-canvas drawer or menu widget.

tags.title: Author Name
tags.note: Outputs the display name of the current post's author.

tags.title: Author Info
tags.note: Retrieves profile information of the post's author (bio, email, website, first name, last name, etc.).

tags.title: Author Meta
tags.note: Retrieves custom user meta data for the post's author by key.

tags.title: Author Profile Picture
tags.note: Outputs the profile picture (avatar) image object or URL for the post's author.

tags.title: Author URL
tags.note: Outputs the archive URL of the post's author.

tags.title: User Info
tags.note: Retrieves profile details of the currently logged-in user (email, display name, bio, etc.).

tags.title: User Profile Picture
tags.note: Outputs the profile avatar image object or URL of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: User/Author Image URL
tags.note: Retrieves the avatar URL for a specified user or post author.

tags.title: User Role
tags.note: Outputs the role(s) (e.g. Administrator, Editor) of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: Current User ID
tags.note: Outputs the numeric database ID of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: Current User Display Name
tags.note: Outputs the display name of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: Current User Email
tags.note: Outputs the email address of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: Current User Registration Date
tags.note: Outputs the registration date of the currently logged-in user.

tags.title: Comments URL
tags.note: Outputs the direct link URL to the comments section of the current post.

tags.title: Comments Number
tags.note: Outputs the total number of approved comments on the current post.

tags.title: Current Term Name
tags.note: Outputs the name of the category or tag term currently being viewed on an archive page.

tags.title: Current Term Description
tags.note: Outputs the description text of the category or tag term currently being viewed.

tags.title: Current Term Image
tags.note: Outputs the image object of the current term from taxonomy metadata (e.g. category image).

tags.title: ACF Field
tags.note: Reads a generic ACF field value by name. Compatible with simple text, select, or number fields.

tags.title: ACF Repeater
tags.note: Allows loop-based rendering or custom extraction of ACF repeater fields.

tags.title: ACF Gallery First Image
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the first image from an ACF gallery field.

tags.title: ACF Relationship First Post Title
tags.note: Retrieves the title of the first related post selected in an ACF relationship field.

tags.title: ACF Taxonomy Term Name
tags.note: Returns the term name selected in an ACF taxonomy field.

tags.title: ACF Date Picker Formatted
tags.note: Retrieves an ACF date picker value and outputs it in a custom format.

tags.title: ACF True/False
tags.note: Evaluates an ACF True/False field and outputs customizable text for each state.

tags.title: ACF Choice
tags.note: Retrieves the value or label of a selected choice from an ACF select, checkbox, or radio field.

tags.title: ACF File
tags.note: Retrieves an ACF file field value as a URL, title, description, or file size.

tags.title: ACF Link URL
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the URL from an ACF link field.

tags.title: ACF Link Text
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the link text/label from an ACF link field.

tags.title: ACF Image Data
tags.note: Retrieves specific properties (URL, Alt text, Title, Width, Height) of an ACF image field.

tags.title: ACF Link Attribute
tags.note: Extracts target link attributes (e.g., target='_blank') from an ACF link field.

tags.title: WooCommerce Is Featured Product
tags.note: Returns 1 if the product is featured in WooCommerce, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: Product Price
tags.note: Outputs the current active price of the product (formatted regular price or sale price).

tags.title: Product Sale Price
tags.note: Outputs the sale price of the product if it is currently discounted.

tags.title: Product SKU
tags.note: Outputs the stock-keeping unit (SKU) code of the current product.

tags.title: Product Stock Status
tags.note: Outputs the stock status of the product (e.g. In stock, Out of stock) and optional quantity.

tags.title: Product Categories
tags.note: Displays a comma-separated list of product categories assigned to the product.

tags.title: Product Rating
tags.note: Outputs the average star rating value of the current product.

tags.title: Product Add To Cart URL
tags.note: Outputs the direct Add-To-Cart URL query string for the current product.

tags.title: SCF Field
tags.note: Reads a generic SCF field value by name. Compatible with simple text, select, or number fields.

tags.title: SCF Repeater
tags.note: Allows loop-based rendering or custom extraction of SCF repeater fields.

tags.title: SCF Gallery First Image
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the first image from an SCF gallery field.

tags.title: SCF Relationship First Post Title
tags.note: Retrieves the title of the first related post selected in an SCF relationship field.

tags.title: SCF Taxonomy Term Name
tags.note: Returns the term name selected in an SCF taxonomy field.

tags.title: SCF Date Picker Formatted
tags.note: Retrieves an SCF date picker value and outputs it in a custom format.

tags.title: SCF True/False
tags.note: Evaluates an SCF True/False field and outputs customizable text for each state.

tags.title: SCF Choice
tags.note: Retrieves the value or label of a selected choice from an SCF select, checkbox, or radio field.

tags.title: SCF File
tags.note: Retrieves an SCF file field value as a URL, title, description, or file size.

tags.title: SCF Link URL
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the URL from an SCF link field.

tags.title: SCF Link Text
tags.note: Extracts and returns only the link text/label from an SCF link field.

tags.title: SCF Image Data
tags.note: Retrieves specific properties (URL, Alt text, Title, Width, Height) of an SCF image field.

tags.title: SCF Link Attribute
tags.note: Extracts target link attributes (e.g., target='_blank') from an SCF link field.

tags.title: WooCommerce Cross-Sell Product IDs
tags.note: Outputs a list of WooCommerce cross-sell product IDs assigned to the current product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Date Created
tags.note: Outputs the date when the product was created.

tags.title: WooCommerce Date Modified
tags.note: Outputs the date when the product was last modified.

tags.title: WooCommerce Gallery Images
tags.note: Retrieves all gallery image objects associated with the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Global Unique ID
tags.note: Outputs the global unique product identifier (e.g., GTIN, EAN, UPC, ISBN).

tags.title: WooCommerce In Stock
tags.note: Returns 1 if the product is currently in stock, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: WooCommerce Is Downloadable
tags.note: Returns 1 if the product is marked as a downloadable product, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: WooCommerce Is Virtual
tags.note: Returns 1 if the product is marked as a virtual product, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: WooCommerce Menu Order
tags.note: Outputs the custom menu order number defined for the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce On Sale
tags.note: Returns 1 if the product is on sale, otherwise returns 0.

tags.title: WooCommerce Parent Product ID
tags.note: Outputs the ID of the parent product (for variations or sub-products).

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Attributes
tags.note: Displays attributes (size, color, weight) associated with the current product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Brands
tags.note: Displays the brand names assigned to the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Description
tags.note: Outputs the full description text of the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Dimensions
tags.note: Outputs the dimensions (Length, Width, Height) formatted according to store settings.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product ID
tags.note: Outputs the database post ID of the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Price HTML
tags.note: Outputs the formatted HTML price string including currency symbols and sale layouts.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Regular Price
tags.note: Outputs the regular product price value (raw number without currency symbols).

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Short Description
tags.note: Outputs the short description (excerpt) of the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Status
tags.note: Outputs the WooCommerce product catalog visibility status.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Tags
tags.note: Displays a list of tags assigned to the product, with optional links.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Title
tags.note: Outputs the title of the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Type
tags.note: Outputs the WooCommerce product type (e.g., simple, variable, grouped, external).

tags.title: WooCommerce Product Weight
tags.note: Outputs the weight of the product formatted according to store settings.

tags.title: WooCommerce Purchase Note
tags.note: Outputs the purchase note displayed to customers after checking out.

tags.title: WooCommerce Rating Distribution
tags.note: Outputs the review rating distribution (star ratings count breakdown).

tags.title: WooCommerce Review Count
tags.note: Outputs the total count of reviews for the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Sale Date From
tags.note: Outputs the date from which the sale price is active.

tags.title: WooCommerce Sale Date To
tags.note: Outputs the date until which the sale price is active.

tags.title: WooCommerce Shipping Class
tags.note: Outputs the shipping class slug or name assigned to the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Stock Quantity
tags.note: Outputs the exact available quantity of stock for the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Tax Status
tags.note: Outputs the tax status of the product (taxable, shipping only, or none).

tags.title: WooCommerce Total Sales
tags.note: Outputs the total number of items sold for the product.

tags.title: WooCommerce Upsell Product IDs
tags.note: Outputs a list of WooCommerce upsell product IDs assigned to the current product.

tags.title: ACF DateTime Formatted

tags.title: Site Admin Email
tags.note: Outputs the administrator email address of the site.

tags.title: Site Language
tags.note: Outputs the active site locale code (e.g. en_US).

tags.title: Site Charset
tags.note: Outputs the configured site character set encoding.

tags.title: Custom Option Value
tags.note: Retrieves any WordPress option value from options table by option name.

tags.title: Theme Name
tags.note: Outputs the name of the active theme.

tags.title: Theme Version
tags.note: Outputs the version of the active theme.

tags.title: Child Theme Name
tags.note: Outputs the child theme name if active, or falls back to parent theme.

tags.title: Active Plugins Count
tags.note: Outputs the total number of currently active plugins on the site.

tags.title: Memory Usage
tags.note: Outputs current PHP memory usage details.

tags.title: Server Time Zone
tags.note: Outputs the WordPress configured timezone setting.

tags.title: Site Tagline with Fallback
tags.note: Outputs the site tagline with a customizable fallback option if empty.

tags.title: Product Title
tags.note: Outputs the title of the current EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product ID
tags.note: Outputs the unique numeric database ID of the current EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product SKU
tags.note: Outputs the SKU code of the current EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Active Price
tags.note: Outputs the active formatted or raw price of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Regular Price
tags.note: Outputs the regular list price of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Sale Price
tags.note: Outputs the sale price of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product On Sale Status
tags.note: Outputs a custom sale badge text if the EasyCommerce product is on sale.

tags.title: Product Stock Quantity
tags.note: Outputs the stock quantity or inventory status of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Total Sales
tags.note: Outputs the total units sold count for the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Rating Average
tags.note: Outputs the average review star rating of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Review Count
tags.note: Outputs the total number of reviews for the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Short Description
tags.note: Outputs the short description or summary of the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Type
tags.note: Outputs the product classification (Physical, Digital, Variable).

tags.title: Product Direct Checkout URL
tags.note: Generates a direct add-to-cart checkout link for the EasyCommerce product.

tags.title: Product Thumbnail Image URL
tags.note: Outputs the direct image URL of the featured product image.

tags.title: Product Gallery Images
tags.note: Outputs gallery image URLs with custom separators.

tags.title: Product Categories
tags.note: Outputs a comma-separated list of product categories.

tags.title: Product Tags
tags.note: Outputs a comma-separated list of product tags.

tags.title: Product Brands
tags.note: Outputs a comma-separated list of product brand taxonomy terms.

tags.title: Product Downloads Count
tags.note: Outputs the total number of digital download files attached to the product.

tags.title: Cart Total Amount
tags.note: Outputs the active user's cart total amount.

tags.title: Cart Item Count
tags.note: Outputs the total quantity of items currently in the active cart.

tags.title: Cart Subtotal
tags.note: Outputs the active cart subtotal amount before shipping and tax.

tags.title: Checkout Page URL
tags.note: Outputs the store checkout page URL.

tags.title: Cart Page URL
tags.note: Outputs the store cart page URL.

tags.title: Store Currency Code
tags.note: Outputs the active store currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, BDT).

tags.title: Store Currency Symbol
tags.note: Outputs the active store currency symbol (e.g. $, €, ৳).

tags.title: Total Store Orders
tags.note: Outputs the total count of completed store orders.

tags.title: Event Start Date
tags.note: Outputs the start date of the event.

tags.title: Event End Date
tags.note: Outputs the end date of the event.

tags.title: Event Start Time
tags.note: Outputs the formatted start time of the event.

tags.title: Event End Time
tags.note: Outputs the formatted end time of the event.

tags.title: Event Venue
tags.note: Outputs the name of the venue where the event takes place.

tags.title: Event Venue URL
tags.note: Outputs the URL of the event venue.

tags.title: Event Organizer
tags.note: Outputs the name of the event organizer.

tags.title: Event Type
tags.note: Outputs the event type taxonomy term.

tags.title: Event URL
tags.note: Outputs the direct link to the event page.

tags.title: Event Custom Link
tags.note: Outputs the custom external link configured for the event.

tags.title: Event Capacity
tags.note: Outputs the total capacity of attendees for the event.

tags.title: Event Booked Seats
tags.note: Outputs the number of booked seats for the event.

tags.title: Event Available Seats
tags.note: Outputs the remaining available seats for the event.

tags.title: Event Status
tags.note: Outputs the current booking status of the event.

tags.title: Event Is Recurring
tags.note: Outputs whether the event is recurring or a single occurrence.

tags.title: Author Name
tags.note: Outputs author name. Supports First Author, Specific Index, or All Authors with custom separators and archive links.

tags.title: Author Bio
tags.note: Outputs the author biographical info / description for guest and user authors.

tags.title: Author Email
tags.note: Outputs the author email address or a mailto: link.

tags.title: Author URL
tags.note: Outputs the author archive URL or website URL with WPML language support.

tags.title: Author Profile Picture
tags.note: Outputs the author avatar supporting custom uploaded guest author avatars and Gravatar.

tags.title: Author Meta
tags.note: Outputs custom author meta or social profiles (Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).

tags.title: Post Authors Count
tags.note: Outputs the total count of authors assigned to the post.

tags.title: Author Posts Count
tags.note: Outputs the total published posts count for the selected author from the author taxonomy.
